name: Test Tours
when_to_use: Explore an application's territory systematically during exploratory testing.

letters.description: Follow the documented user path as the company intends it.
Test the parts that generate revenue or handle payments.
Head straight for the famous, central, most-used functions.
Stress the complex logic that exercises the developers' minds.
Use the application in ways it was not necessarily designed for.
Explore with unexpected data, locales, or user types.
Attack the application's handling of hostile or malicious input.

example: Run the Back Alley tour on an admin panel to find undocumented paths and unhandled states.
